task: Implement WP3 from the accepted planner/simulation migration dossier on the exact latest tip of migration/svelte-routing-selected-system, created from the green migration/svelte-cypress-hard-cut head after WP2. Read CLAUDE.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/development/v3-application-stack-decision.md, issue #580, PR #578, current apps/web platform/persistence contracts, React useHashRoute/selected-system/navigation/overlay code, API share-route ownership, and every relevant unit/Cypress/Review Lab test before editing. This packet owns canonical Svelte routing, legacy-link compatibility and selected-system state ownership; it does not port feature bodies. Establish one explicit route grammar and typed route-state layer for all currently accepted mounted journeys, including home/explore/finder, inspect/system detail, colony planner with optional project/mode, My Work, compare/review, profile/owner/admin/operator surfaces, journal import and other mounted top-level application destinations discovered in the React router. Preserve exact FastAPI ownership of /api/*, exact /openapi.json and numeric /s/{id64}; Svelte must never capture them. Convert accepted legacy hash URLs and nested planner detail URLs to canonical Svelte paths/query state with idempotent redirects, preserving query parameters and canonical lossless decimal-string id64 values through uint64 max. Reject malformed percent encoding, unknown route tokens, unsafe/trailing segments and out-of-range identifiers with honest 404/error handling; do not render generic placeholders for typos. Define selected-system ownership so: canonical route state is authoritative on cold/direct navigation; persisted durable selected-system context is fallback only when no route selection exists; transient System Detail overlay selection lives in URL query state and never overwrites durable planner/system context unless an explicit user command requests that; close/Escape/back/forward restore the previous URL and focus correctly; reload, browser history, direct links and cross-tab storage updates remain deterministic; stale hydration cannot overwrite a newer URL or user navigation; and numeric/string conversions cannot round id64. Preserve legacy shared links used by React users, including hash links and numeric backend share-stop routes, without creating a broad backend catch-all. Provide framework-neutral route parser/serializer helpers and SvelteKit load/redirect modules rather than distributing ad-hoc string parsing through components. Update the application shell/navigation only as needed to consume the typed route state; do not build Finder, Inspect, Planner or Review feature UI in this packet. Add exhaustive Vitest table tests for parse/serialize/canonicalization/invalid input, history and URL-vs-storage ownership tests, Svelte component tests for overlay/back/focus interactions, and Cypress cold-load/reload/back-forward/deep-link/legacy-hash/near-prefix/backend-route journeys. Add repository contracts proving governed routes use the central parser, backend-owned paths are excluded, and no route id64 passes through Number/parseInt/unary-plus. Preserve existing Review Lab/Cypress authority and no Playwright. Do not change backend/database schema, game mechanics, API response models, persistence envelopes, React code except a narrowly necessary parity fixture (prefer none), release/deployment authority, production, DNS, secrets, recovery or live data. Run apps/web install/check/lint/format/test/build, focused Cypress dynamic-route/history tests, relevant React route parity tests and Python repository contracts. Push the complete bounded result directly to migration/svelte-routing-selected-system through the wrapper's exact-head lease. End with the final route grammar, legacy mappings, ownership rules, checks/results, deliberately deferred feature consumers and remaining risks.
